title: VesselBranch
description: One node in an arterial or venous tree graph, same structural pattern as NerveBranch. Arterial trees root at the heart (aorta); venous trees are stored root-at-heart too (direction of blood flow is 'leafward to root'), so both use identical parent/child topology and engine/vascular_tree.py graph checks.

approx_diameter_mm.description: typical adult lumen diameter, where documented; governs whether this vessel is individually modeled (>=1mm, per the atlas resolution target) or aggregated into a capillary-bed region below the resolution limit

anastomoses_with.description: other vessel ids this connects to directly (e.g. genicular anastomosis, palmar arches) — makes the graph not strictly a tree at these points, handled explicitly as extra edges
